origin.ref: public string BuyerId { get; private set; }
public int Quantity { get; private set; }
public decimal UnitPrice { get; private set; }

assumptions.text: Deleting a basket also deletes its basket lines through the EF Core relationship
The anonymous and signed-in basket lines are distinct records
No baskets or basket lines exist initially

decisions.text: A basket line is identified by its basket and catalog item; the caller resolves the line key
Basket quantities are integers in the range zero through Int32.MaxValue

language_gaps.text: Adding quantities can overflow a signed 32-bit integer; overflow behavior is not specified by this model
Basket.TotalItems sums all line quantities; an aggregate across a basket is not expressed here
The database assigns basket-line identities; the caller supplies the abstract key used in this model
Total units across all lines during merge were not proven within the solver budget; per-line merge behavior is modeled

properties.text: basket line quantities are never negative
adding an existing item increases that line's quantity
adding units to an existing line does not change its unit price
a new line stores its basket, item, quantity, and unit price
an out-of-range quantity does not create or change a line
a submitted quantity replaces the existing line quantity
changing a line quantity does not reprice it
a line omitted from the submitted quantities is not changed
cleanup removes zero-quantity lines from the selected basket
cleanup preserves other baskets' lines and nonempty lines
merging into an existing shopper line adds the anonymous quantity
when a shopper already has an item, their existing unit price takes precedence
an item missing from the shopper basket is copied from the anonymous line
deleting a basket removes the basket and its lines
